import numpy as np

def layer_norm(x, eps=1e-5):
    mean = np.mean(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    std = np.std(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return (x - mean) / (std + eps)

def encoder_block(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_ff1, W_ff2, num_heads):
    Q = np.matmul(x, W_q)
    K = np.matmul(x, W_k)
    V = np.matmul(x, W_v)
    d_k = K.shape[-1] // num_heads
    heads = []
    for i in range(num_heads):
        q_h = Q[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        k_h = K[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        v_h = V[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        scores = np.matmul(q_h, k_h.T) / np.sqrt(k_h.shape[-1])
        e_x = np.exp(scores - np.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
        attn = e_x / np.sum(e_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        heads.append(np.matmul(attn, v_h))
    concat = np.concatenate(heads, axis=-1)
    attn_out = np.matmul(concat, W_o)
    x1 = layer_norm(x + attn_out)
    ffn = np.matmul(np.maximum(np.matmul(x1, W_ff1), 0), W_ff2)
    return layer_norm(x1 + ffn)

def decoder_block(x, enc_output, W_q1, W_k1, W_v1, W_o1,
                  W_q2, W_k2, W_v2, W_o2, W_ff1, W_ff2, num_heads):
    seq_len = x.shape[0]
    mask = np.triu(np.ones((seq_len, seq_len)) * -1e9, k=1)
    Q1 = np.matmul(x, W_q1)
    K1 = np.matmul(x, W_k1)
    V1 = np.matmul(x, W_v1)
    scores1 = np.matmul(Q1, K1.T) / np.sqrt(K1.shape[-1] // num_heads)
    scores1 += mask
    e1 = np.exp(scores1 - np.max(scores1, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    a1 = e1 / np.sum(e1, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    attn1 = np.matmul(a1, V1)
    x1 = layer_norm(x + np.matmul(attn1, W_o1))
    Q2 = np.matmul(x1, W_q2)
    K2 = np.matmul(enc_output, W_k2)
    V2 = np.matmul(enc_output, W_v2)
    scores2 = np.matmul(Q2, K2.T) / np.sqrt(K2.shape[-1] // num_heads)
    e2 = np.exp(scores2 - np.max(scores2, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    a2 = e2 / np.sum(e2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    attn2 = np.matmul(a2, V2)
    x2 = layer_norm(x1 + np.matmul(attn2, W_o2))
    ffn = np.matmul(np.maximum(np.matmul(x2, W_ff1), 0), W_ff2)
    return layer_norm(x2 + ffn)

def transformer(src_tokens, tgt_tokens,
                src_embed, tgt_embed, pos_encoding,
                encoder_params, decoder_params, output_linear,
                num_layers, num_heads):
    src = np.matmul(src_tokens, src_embed)
    src += pos_encoding[:src.shape[0]]
    tgt = np.matmul(tgt_tokens, tgt_embed)
    tgt += pos_encoding[:tgt.shape[0]]
    enc_out = src
    for i in range(num_layers):
        params = encoder_params[i]
        enc_out = encoder_block(enc_out, params["W_q"], params["W_k"],
                                params["W_v"], params["W_o"],
                                params["W_ff1"], params["W_ff2"], num_heads)
    dec_out = tgt
    for i in range(num_layers):
        params = decoder_params[i]
        dec_out = decoder_block(dec_out, enc_out,
                                params["W_q1"], params["W_k1"], params["W_v1"], params["W_o1"],
                                params["W_q2"], params["W_k2"], params["W_v2"], params["W_o2"],
                                params["W_ff1"], params["W_ff2"], num_heads)
    return np.matmul(dec_out, output_linear)
